t: A powerful machine used to craft materials using up to $(6)8$() items and/or $(6)1$() fluid. This machine can produce items and/or fluids. $(br2)All the recipes are shapeless meaning that the ingredients can be in any slot. $(br2)When a recipe is present the machine will lock all of the slots to prevent more items from being inserted.
一种功能强大的合成机器，最多可同时使用$(6)8$()件物品和/或$(6)1$()种流体进行合成。该机器可产出物品和/或流体。$(br2)所有配方均为无序配方，即原料可放入任意槽位。$(br2)当配方存在时，机器将锁定全部槽位，防止额外物品被插入。
